content: FEEL boxed expressions (Clause 10): 10 types - decision table, boxed literal expression, boxed invocation (named params, >=1 required), boxed context (name/value pairs + optional result, names distinct), boxed list, relation (homogeneous contexts displayed as table), boxed function definition (kind FEEL/PMML/Java + params + body), boxed conditional (if/then/else 3 rows), boxed filter (collection + bracketed filter), boxed iterator (for/some/every). Recursive. Grammar rules 1-65. Key constructs: for...in...return (list output, multi iteration contexts = cross product), if...then...else, some/every...in...satisfies (quantified, empty->false/true respectively), context {k:v}, list [...], function definition. 3-valued logic (true/false/null). Semantic domain: number(Decimal128/34 digits), string, boolean, date, time, date-and-time, days-time-duration, years-months-duration, list, context, function, range, null, any. Type lattice with equivalence and conformance relations.
